# Examination document rendering

Pinned browser bundles copied from npm packages: docx-preview 0.4.1, JSZip 3.10.1, html2canvas 1.4.1, and pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 (legacy build). Their licences are included alongside the bundles. Files are served locally from the school's portal; documents are not sent to a third-party converter.

PDF and Word .docx papers are rendered to page images in the staff browser. Staff must check every page and confirm the preview. The original document and rendered pages are stored privately; candidates only receive rendered pages during their own active examination.
